field_edits.updated_text: Mild multilevel degenerative spondylotic changes with small marginal endplate osteophytes. Five lumbar-type vertebral bodies are identified. Normal density and alignment. No fracture or osseous lesion.

impression:
1. Mild multilevel degenerative spondylotic changes of the lumbar spine with small marginal endplate osteophytes.
2. Visualized sacroiliac joints are unremarkable.
3. No acute fracture or dislocation.
